en: Sepia-toned photograph of a low, long, plastered house with a steep clay-tile roof and several chimneys, facing directly onto a narrow street. A well‑dressed man in a suit stands in the open doorway on the left. The windows display household goods or clothing, suggesting a small shop or mixed dwelling-shop. The architecture and street are typical of an early‑20th‑century Northern or Central European town. A handwritten number "6057" appears in the lower left corner; a small oval sign with an unreadable number or letters hangs beside the doorway.
